missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Секретарь' is a masculine soft-sign noun in the nominative as the subject of 'работает'. 'Новый' is the agreeing masculine adjective, and 'быстро' describes the work.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative. 'Секретаря' is animate masculine, so its accusative equals the genitive as the object of 'вызвал'. The stress shifts onto the ending in the oblique forms.
Strategic focus: Genitive of possession. 'Секретаря' takes the genitive after 'у' to show whose workload it is. 'Много работы' completes the possession frame.
Strategic focus: Dative recipient. 'Секретарю' is the dative recipient of 'передал', the person to whom the documents went. 'Документы' is the accusative object.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of role. 'Секретарём' takes the instrumental to name the job held. 'В фирме' is the prepositional location of the work.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'Секретаре' takes the prepositional after 'о' to mean talking about the secretary. 'Новом' agrees in the masculine prepositional.
Strategic focus: Genitive after preposition. 'Секретаря' takes the genitive after 'без', expressing the absence on which the office depends. The clause shows the consequence.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Секретари' is the nominative plural subject with end stress. 'Опытные' agrees in the plural, and 'в компании' sets the place.
Strategic focus: Animate accusative plural. 'Секретарей' is animate, so the accusative plural equals the genitive plural as the object of 'благодарит'. The boss thanks the staff.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of agent. 'Секретарём' takes the instrumental to name who signed in this passive construction. 'Подписан' is the short passive participle.
